en.name: Zenomancer
en.ability: One or more players each have a goal. When achieved, that player learns a piece of true info.
en.flavor: The universe is a verb not a noun, they say, and it is turtles, turtles all the way down. Turtles all the way down, my friend, turtles all the way down.
